note: MDC community lake (14 acres, two flooded clay pits) south of Wellsville. The primitive camping area is the south end of the gravel lot and turnaround at the boat ramp, against the woods; nothing built (no pads, tables, toilets or water). The lake is in view past the ramp, about 30 m off. An unstaffed shooting range is about 110 m north on the same entrance road. Gravel county and area roads in. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC marks a Primitive Camping Area (map symbol + GIS point) at the south edge of the ramp lot - a designated point at a lot, so it stays; it is a lot, not a built camp. Phone matches. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Lakeview stands (~30-35 m, ramp approach between). Pin fine.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS (designated point at a lot): the page lists 'Designated Camping Sites'; the brochure says 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas'; the 04/15 map legend has 'Primitive Camping Area' and draws the symbol beside the Parking Lot square at the west end of the lake, next to the Boat Ramp; GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 39.03451,-91.58039, 24 m from the lot's GIS point. Imagery: a gravel lot roughly 25 x 60 m with a turnaround loop round a grass island, the ramp leaving its east side; the camping point is on the lot's south-east corner where the gravel meets the woods. Nothing built is visible. BUILT CAMP OR LOT: a lot.

WATERFRONT - LAKEVIEW STANDS: from the camping point the water is about 30-35 m east and north-east; the line north-east runs over the open gravel ramp approach (day use), the line east through a thin strip of shoreline trees. The lake is 14 acres (map label), over the pond threshold. With the ramp approach between it is a view, not on-water.

SHOOTING RANGE: the map's Shooting Range symbol and the range building on imagery are about 110 m north of the camping point on the entrance road ('an unstaffed shooting range that was built in 1975'). Said in the note.
ACCESS: County Road 27 (gravel) 0.25 mile, then about 600 m of area gravel road; no ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording. No campsite season or fire restriction in the brochure.
PIN: stored pin = the GIS camping point, on the gravel edge. No move.
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.
